# Customer and demand

> Customer discovery and demand estimation: interviews and surveys with their biases, experiments, discrete choice models, segmentation, and a protocol shape for a customer study. The first review is written, a first pass of 40 sources ending on the baseline B1.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [Customer and demand](https://tewf.github.io/business-customer/README.md): the scope, what the review found and the baseline
- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/business-customer/evidence/README.md): the review, the bibliography and the claims with their grades
- [Customer demand review](https://tewf.github.io/business-customer/evidence/customer-demand/README.md): frame, protocol, sources, review, state of the art, position, against and the baseline B1
- [Customer study shape](https://tewf.github.io/business-customer/shapes/customer-study.md): the protocol of a study, with a filled fixture and a check
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/business-customer/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/business-customer/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics/standard.md): the reader-ergonomics card this repository obeys
